name: OpenChurch
install:
command -v /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql-16; }
cd /agent/repos/OpenChurch && npm run install:all
start: cd /agent/repos/OpenChurch && sudo env "PATH=$PATH" node scripts/local-db.mjs up

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd /agent/repos/OpenChurch && sudo env "PATH=$PATH" node scripts/local-db.mjs up && cd server && DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres@localhost:5433/openchurch_local' JWT_SECRET='local-dev-jwt-secret-change-me-please' CHECKIN_CODE_PEPPER='local-dev-checkin-pepper' PORT=3034 npm run dev
